ai.overview: Arizona puts the College Basketball Belt on the line when they host New Orleans on December 1, 2026. The Wildcats have defended the belt 3 times in this reign and enter on a 5-game winning streak, while New Orleans has never held the belt in its history and comes in having lost to Grambling 80-81 in their most recent outing.
key_matchups: Arizona's 5-game winning streak and 7-1 record against New Orleans' struggles, dropping their last game and sitting at 1-3
The Wildcats' dominant all-time edge in this series, having won all 3 previous meetings dating back to the early 1990s
New Orleans seeking their first-ever belt possession against a confident Arizona team that has won by margins including 84-73, 84-66, and 96-83 in recent games
ai.betting_angles: Arizona enters as a clear Elo favorite with strong recent form, having won their last 5 games including an 84-73 victory over Ole Miss. The Wildcats are 7-1 this season while New Orleans sits at 1-3 and just fell 80-81 to Grambling. The all-time head-to-head heavily favors Arizona at 3-0, with the Wildcats winning by scores of 80-62, 72-69, and 82-64 in their three previous meetings.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona has won their last 5 games and boasts a 7-1 record, while New Orleans is 1-3 and coming off an 80-81 loss to Grambling. The Wildcats have never lost to New Orleans in 3 all-time meetings, including an 80-62 victory in their last clash in 1993. New Orleans has struggled badly on the road this season with losses of 41-86 at Texas Tech and 57-100 at LSU. Arizona should comfortably defend the belt at home and extend their reign to 4 successful defenses.
